msg: the game seems to assign a group of gnomes to be the "high value" gnomes at the start. those gnomes will generally give more mushrooms for a period of time, before their value starts to drop and the opposite gnome in the pair will begin to rise in value. The points seem to run from 0 to 8, and the high value gnomes will start to drop after a while. The time it takes for them to lower in value seems to get shorter with each round of the game. By round four, the "high value" group seemed to switch every two to three gome selections. In my game, the colour groupings were: blue, red, pink, purple and orange, yellow, green, brown. When red was high, blue, pink and purple were also high.
